text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor issued written eviction pressure notices; threatening documents were left in the tenant's mailbox; legal counsel review was skipped
2) the actor disabled utility service to the unit; the shut-off record remained in the provider's log; habitability certification was skipped
3) the actor replaced the unit's entry locks; discarded key and lock parts were left in the hallway; tenant re-entry protocol was skipped
4) the actor reduced heating to create unlivable conditions; the thermostat change log was left active; safety threshold review was skipped
5) the actor delayed responding to maintenance complaints; complaint tickets remained open in the property system; regulatory audit response was skipped
6) the actor removed the smoke detector batteries; the dead detector unit was left in the ceiling; life-safety inspection was skipped
7) the actor kept handwritten pressure notes on the office desk; the note pages were left unsecured; evidence preservation review was skipped
8) the actor ignored scheduled housing inspection requests; the unanswered notices were left in the compliance file; statutory response deadline was skipped

note: the described conduct matches illegal lockouts, utility shutoffs, and housing-code violations that expose the operator to civil penalties, criminal charges, and tenant damages; this summary is for after-action review only and does not endorse or provide instructions for such acts.
